title: Surface hierarchy and contextual workspace switch patterns
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: The current Redwood Console sidebar and top-level routing are inconsistent across features (dashboards, rollouts, cost views). Users reported disorientation when switching contexts and unclear affordances for workspace scope. Goal: define a concise surface hierarchy and contextual workspace switching patterns that scale across: dashboards, rollout workflows, model pages, and cost breakdowns. Deliverables: annotated IA map, low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes, interaction spec for quick-switcher and contextual breadcrumbs, accessibility checklist, and handoff-ready component specs. Constraints: must work within existing top-level product routes, maintain single-click access to primary flows, and preserve space for upcoming beta features (canary rollouts, per-route cost drilldowns).
decisions: Adopt a hybrid left-rail + contextual top bar: persistent primary nav on left, contextual breadcrumbs and actions in top bar.
Make workspace switcher a lightweight overlay (keyboard accessible) instead of a full page redirect to reduce context loss.
Group cost, usage, and billing into a 'Cost & Usage' cluster in primary nav rather than burying under settings.
Introduce a small visual badge for 'active workspace scope' in the header to reduce accidental cross-workspace edits.
tradeoffs: Compact sidebar increases density but reduces discoverability for lesser-used tools; mitigated with progressive disclosure and a 'favorites' slot.
Overlay switcher keeps users in context but complicates deep-linking to explicit workspace URLs; decided to add optional query param for direct links.
Separating cost into its own cluster adds one extra click for billing-admin flows that currently live in settings; justified by improved mental model for product teams.
feedback_and_reviews: 2025-02-12 - PM Review (Marco Nguyen): prefer overlay switcher but requested keyboard shortcut and deep-link support.
2025-02-14 - Engineering Feedback (Priya Shah): noted runtime constraints for initial load; suggested lazy-loading non-essential nav icons.
2025-02-17 - Accessibility Review (Liam O'Connor): requested larger hit targets in compact mode and aria-live announcements for workspace change.
2025-02-19 - Design Crit (Full team): preference for top-bar contextual actions to include 'Switch to Dedicated' CTA for enterprise users; flagged as follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: IA diagram annotated and approved by PM and Eng (sign-off comment in ticket).
Prototype demonstrates overlay switcher with keyboard shortcut and deep-link behavior.
Handoff docs include CSS tokens, spacing, and aria attributes required for accessibility.
Performance notes from ENG indicating sidebar lazy-load approach and initial render cost are captured.
Usability test (n=6) shows users can switch workspace and find cost dashboards within 3 clicks in the majority of sessions.
